summary: After a support-run install, your installation fully owns its web app sign-in registration.

fixes.title: Ownership handover now completes
fixes.text: When Invardia's Support app ran the install, it stayed an owner of the web app's sign-in registration. It now removes itself once the installation's own identity is in place.

fixes.title: No false owner warnings
fixes.text: The install now waits briefly for Entra to show a new owner, instead of warning about one that was added.
